verdict.rationale: Firecrawl offers hosted scraping via API/SDK with built-in interactive actions (click, fill, extract, navigate) and a managed Browser Sandbox, letting developers scrape without running their own crawler/browser infrastructure. However, the evidence shows only Firecrawl's predefined actions/endpoints, not a general mechanism to write and deploy arbitrary custom scraping scripts as serverless functions on the platform. Missing for 10: evidence of custom code/script deployment (e.g., a functions/actions runtime for arbitrary logic), documentation of scaling/execution limits for such scripts, and independent confirmation of this deploy-your-own-script workflow.
